user.title: Map Overlay Button
user.description: Adds the Map Overlay Button card to your dashboards: Home Assistant's map with a button on top that does what you choose. After this, edit a dashboard, add a card and pick Map Overlay Button.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Map Overlay Button is already set up.

create_entry.default: Done. Reload this page once (press F5, pull down on a phone or tablet, or restart a kiosk app) so your browser loads the card. Then edit a dashboard, choose Add card and pick Map Overlay Button.
